seoTitle: Riverside Unified 2027–28 Calendar: Key Dates & PDF
seoDescription: Riverside Unified (RUSD) 2027–28 calendar with the 7th-grade start date, grade-specific final days, holidays, major recesses, official PDF, and ICS download.
heroSummary: Riverside Unified classes begin Monday, August 9, 2027. Seventh graders start earlier, on Friday, August 6. High school and 7th grade students finish May 25, while elementary and 8th grade students finish May 26.
verificationBadgeText: Reviewed August 14, 2026 · Source: Riverside Unified School District
calendarNotes: Seventh grade starts August 6, before general classes begin August 9. Parent/teacher conferences run November 4–5, when elementary students are not in session. Elementary minimum days fall October 29, February 18, and May 19. High school and 7th grade end May 25; elementary and 8th grade end May 26.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Riverside Unified start school in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Classes begin on Monday, August 9, 2027. The first day for 7th grade is Friday, August 6, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: Are elementary students in school during RUSD parent/teacher conferences?
calendarFaqs.a: No. RUSD lists parent/teacher conferences for November 4–5, 2027, with elementary students not in session.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Riverside Unified Spring Recess in 2028?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Recess runs Monday, March 27 through Friday, March 31, 2028.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of school for Riverside Unified in 2028?
calendarFaqs.a: High school and 7th grade end May 25, 2028. Elementary and 8th grade end May 26, 2028.

calendarFaqs.q: Does every RUSD school follow exactly the same calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: RUSD publishes a districtwide Calendar at a Glance, but some dates apply only to certain grade levels or school types. Individual schools may also publish campus-specific events, testing dates, bell schedules, and other schedule changes.

calendarFaqs.q: Where can I get the official Riverside Unified 2027–28 calendar PDF?
calendarFaqs.a: Use the official RUSD Calendar at a Glance PDF linked in the downloads section. MySchoolDates also provides a separate one-time ICS file for the reviewed dates on this page.

definitions.description: Seventh graders begin Friday, August 6, three days before general classes begin Monday, August 9.

definitions.term: Elementary students are out for conferences
definitions.description: Parent/teacher conferences run November 4–5, and elementary students are not in session.
Elementary minimum days fall October 29, February 18, and May 19.

definitions.term: Days off for middle and high school students
definitions.description: Middle school students are not in session October 8 or March 10. Middle and high school students are not in session December 17.

definitions.term: The school year ends on two dates
definitions.description: High school and 7th grade finish May 25; elementary and 8th grade finish May 26.

customSections.label: What Changed from 2026–27?
customSections.content: Compared with 2026–27, RUSD starts and ends earlier, while Winter Recess is longer.

groups.label: Changes
items: General classes begin August 9, one day earlier than in 2026–27.
Both grade-level ending dates move one day earlier: May 25 for high school and 7th grade, and May 26 for elementary and 8th grade.
Winter Recess expands to December 20–January 3, compared with December 21–January 1 in 2026–27.
